bearerAuth.description: Session token (secrets.token_urlsafe), выдаётся при регистрации или входе. Срок действия: 6 часов.

adminApiKey.name: Authorization
adminApiKey.description: BOT_ADMIN_KEY из файла .env. Используется для админских эндпоинтов.

adminJwt.description: Admin JWT access token obtained from /api/v1/auth/admin/token

WebRegisterRequest.description: WebRegisterRequest represents the registration payload for creating a new user account via the web interface.

password.description: User password (hashed with bcrypt on server)

tg_id.description: Telegram user ID (optional, can be linked later via /auth/telegram/link)

WebLoginRequest.description: WebLoginRequest represents the login payload for authenticating with username and password.

WebPasswordChangeRequest.description: WebPasswordChangeRequest represents the payload for changing user password.

WebTelegramLinkRequest.description: WebTelegramLinkRequest represents the payload for linking a Telegram account to a web account.

TelegramLoginRequest.description: TelegramLoginRequest represents the payload for logging in via Telegram.

ManualPaymentConfirmRequest.description: ManualPaymentConfirmRequest represents the payload for manually confirming a payment.

PartnerStatsRequest.description: PartnerStatsRequest represents the payload for requesting partner statistics.

BotTelegramLoginRequest.description: BotTelegramLoginRequest represents the payload for bot-assisted Telegram login.

state.description: One-time state token from /auth/bot/create-login-state (valid for 5 minutes)

Tariff.description: Tariff represents a subscription plan with pricing, traffic limits, and server configuration.

active.description: Whether the tariff is currently available for purchase

trial.description: Whether this is a trial (free) tariff

Location.description: Location represents a server location with flag and label information.

CustomTariffRequest.description: CustomTariffRequest represents the payload for generating a custom tariff plan.

servers.description: List of server locations to include

UserProfile.description: UserProfile represents a sanitized user profile for API responses (without sensitive fields).

has_subscription.description: Whether the user has an active subscription

is_mate.description: Whether the user is a partner

SubscriptionState.description: SubscriptionState represents the current state of a user subscription.

is_expiring_soon.description: Whether the subscription expires within Config.EXPIRY_ALERT_DAYS

CreateSubscriptionRequest.description: CreateSubscriptionRequest represents the payload for creating or renewing a subscription.

user_id.description: Target user ID (required for admin endpoints)

ip_limit.description: Custom IP limit (optional, uses tariff default)

ExtendSubscriptionRequest.description: ExtendSubscriptionRequest represents the payload for extending a subscription by a number of days.

BanUserRequest.description: BanUserRequest represents the payload for banning a user.

CreateCheckoutRequest.description: CreateCheckoutRequest represents the payload for creating a payment checkout session.

PaymentRecord.description: PaymentRecord represents a payment transaction in the system.

user_id.description: User ID who made the payment

plan_id.description: Tariff ID associated with the payment

PaymentVerifyRequest.description: PaymentVerifyRequest represents the payload for verifying (confirming or rejecting) a payment.

admin_note.description: Optional admin note for the verification

PartnerProfile.description: PartnerProfile represents a partner account profile with balance, commission, subscription and referral information.

is_mate.description: Whether the user is a partner

PartnerApplication.description: PartnerApplication represents a partner program application.

followers.description: Number of followers on social media

nickname.description: Partner nickname (English letters, digits, _ only, no spaces or special chars)

pd_consent.description: Personal data processing consent (1 = yes, 0 = no)

PartnerStats.description: PartnerStats represents partner program statistics for a given period.

ReferralRecord.description: ReferralRecord represents a referral entry in the referral program.

has_subscription.description: Whether the referral has an active subscription

bonus_days.description: Bonus days earned from this referral

BroadcastRequest.description: BroadcastRequest represents a mass message send request.

target_user_ids.description: Target user IDs (empty = send to all)

CreateClientRequest.description: CreateClientRequest represents a payload for creating a client in the VPN panel.

inbound_ids.description: List of inbound IDs to attach

BulkActionRequest.description: BulkActionRequest represents a bulk user operation.

user_ids.description: List of user IDs to operate on

DebugCleanupRequest.description: DebugCleanupRequest represents a database cleanup operation request.

dry_run.description: If true, only calculate what would be deleted without actually deleting

cleanup_traffic_exhausted.description: Clean up users who exhausted their traffic

cleanup_missing.description: Clean up clients missing from the VPN panel

user_id.description: User ID to clear abuse status

info.title: Phantom VPN Bot API
info.description: Programmatic interface for the Phantom VPN Telegram bot. Authenticate with username + password or via Telegram. Email is not used for authentication.

get.description: Public endpoint to check API availability. No authentication required.

get.summary: Get feature flags and public configuration
get.description: Returns public feature flags, payment methods, and configured payment details.
Detailed system health check including users, payments, and partner operations. Requires admin API key.
Detailed panel information including server status and nodes. Returns full unsanitized data including panel_base. Requires admin API key.

server_status.description: Full server status including IP and port (admin only)

items.description: Full node data including address, port, apiToken (admin only)

post.description: Create a new user account with username and password. Telegram ID is optional and can be linked later via /auth/telegram/link.
Authenticate with username and password. Returns a session token valid for 6 hours.
Invalidate the current session token.

get.description: Returns the profile of the authenticated user (without password_hash or session_token).

post.description: Update user password after verifying the old one. Password is hashed with bcrypt. New password must meet minimum length requirement (PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH).

Link a Telegram user ID to the current web account. Requires a valid Telegram verification state created by /auth/telegram/link/start. Returns 403 if state is missing, expired, or tg_id does not match the verified state. Returns 409 if Telegram is already linked to another account.

409.description: Telegram already linked to another account

post.description: Unlink the Telegram user ID from the current web account.

Login to an existing web account via Telegram ID. Requires a valid Telegram verification state created by /auth/telegram/start. Returns 403 if state is missing, expired, or tg_id does not match the verified state.

404.description: No web account linked to this Telegram user

post.description: Create a one-time state token for bot-assisted login. State is valid for 5 minutes (TTL=300). Returns a Telegram deep-link URL to open in the bot.

url.description: Deep-link URL to open in Telegram bot

500.description: Bot username not configured or state creation failed

post.description: Create a state token for linking Telegram to a web account via bot. Requires authentication. Returns a Telegram deep-link URL.

500.description: Bot username not configured or state creation failed

get.description: Poll the status of a Telegram authentication state created by /auth/telegram/start or /auth/telegram/link-start.
Public endpoint. Returns all active tariffs from the catalog (tarifs.json).

post.description: Calculate the cost of a custom plan with traffic, IP, and duration parameters. Requires authentication.

get.description: Returns bounds and coefficients for generating custom tariffs. Requires authentication (session token or admin API key).
Public endpoint. Returns a list of available server locations with flags and labels.
Returns a paginated list of users. Requires admin API key.
Search by user_id or email (internal VPN panel email). Requires admin API key.
Returns data for a specific user (without password_hash). Requires admin API key.

delete.description: Completely delete a user from the system. Requires admin rights. Clears session tokens before deletion. Admin users are protected and cannot be deleted.

403.description: Admin required or cannot delete admin user

get.description: Returns the full subscription state: status, remaining traffic, days until expiry, servers.

post.description: Admin subscription creation for a user. Automatically creates a client in the VPN panel.
Completely remove a user subscription from bot and VPN panel. Admin users are protected and cannot have their subscription removed.
Extend a user subscription by a specified number of days. Automatically updates the expiry in the VPN panel.
Block user access. Blocks in bot and VPN panel.
Remove block from a user.
Purchase a subscription from the catalog tariff. Automatically creates a client in the VPN panel and generates a VPN link.
Renew an existing subscription with a catalog tariff.
Activate a trial (free) subscription. Only available for users without an active subscription.

get.description: Returns the VPN link and JSON link for an active subscription.

post.description: Add extra traffic (GB) to an active subscription.

get.description: Public endpoint to verify the validity of a subscription by subscription ID.

post.description: Create a payment session. Generates a payment_id and returns a payment URL (Yoomoney).

get.description: List of all payments awaiting confirmation.

post.description: DEPRECATED: use /api/v1/payments/verify/{payment_id} (status=confirmed) instead. Manually confirm a payment by a moderator. Issues subscription and bonuses.
DEPRECATED: use /api/v1/payments/verify/{payment_id} (status=rejected) instead. Manually reject a payment by a moderator.
Verify a payment with confirmation or rejection. Requires admin rights.

get.description: Full payment history with pagination and status filtering.
Returns public partner program configuration: commission percent, requirements, terms URL, period limits, bonus days, and trust points.
Get partner account information: balance, commission, status, referrals.

post.description: Submit an application to join the partner program. Requires authentication. Nickname must contain only English letters, digits and _. Referral link format: t.me/bot?start=mate_{nickname}.

400.description: Invalid application data (nickname format, period range)

403.description: Admins cannot become partners or partner program disabled

get.description: Returns whether the authenticated user has a pending partner application.

post.description: Request a withdrawal from the partner balance via SBP (System of Instant Payments). Requires fio, phone, and bank for the withdrawal.

400.description: Invalid amount, missing fio, phone, or bank

409.description: Insufficient balance or pending request exists

get.description: Detailed partner statistics: referrals, payouts, bonuses.
Referral program statistics: total referrals, paying referrals, bonuses.
List of all operations awaiting in the system.
List of partner operations for moderation.

post.description: Send a notification to all users or only subscribers.
Create a client in the 3X-UI panel. Automatically generates email user_{id}@vpn.com.

get.description: Get the list of clients from the 3X-UI panel.

delete.description: Delete a client from the 3X-UI panel by subscription ID.

get.description: Get the current authenticated user's profile with subscription, referrals, and partner information.

patch.description: Update the current user's interface language preference.

language.description: Language code (e.g. ru, en, pl, zh)

get.description: System statistics: total users, subscribers, partners.
Public panel status information including server status and nodes. Returns only fields required for public rendering.
Returns complete user information: data, subscription, referrals, partner, payments, panel data.

post.description: Remove all user data: subscription, referrals, partner, payments. Admin users are protected and cannot be reset.

403.description: Admin required or cannot reset admin user

post.description: Send a personal message to a user via Telegram bot.
Bulk user status changes: ban/unban/remove subscription.

skipped_admins.description: Number of admin users skipped (admins are protected from modification)

get.description: Export user data in JSON or CSV format.

post.description: Clean up expired records: expired subscriptions, exhausted traffic, missing clients. Supports dry-run mode.

get.description: Search users by query for debugging purposes. Requires admin API key.

websocket.description: WebSocket endpoint for real-time user notifications. Connect with user_id path parameter.

WebSocket endpoint for admin connections. Authentication is performed via the `Authorization: Bearer <BOT_ADMIN_KEY>` header (recommended). The `{admin_key}` path parameter is DEPRECATED and will be removed in a future release; do not use it in new clients.

parameters.name: admin_key
parameters.description: DEPRECATED: pass BOT_ADMIN_KEY in the Authorization header instead.

post.description: DEPRECATED: path renamed to /api/v1/users/{user_id}/ban-by-uid. Use that endpoint instead. The old `uid` parameter is now `user_id`. Ban a user by their user ID (UID). Requires admin API key.
DEPRECATED: path renamed to /api/v1/users/{user_id}/unban-by-uid. Use that endpoint instead. The old `uid` parameter is now `user_id`. Unban a user by their user ID (UID). Requires admin API key.
Exchange BOT_ADMIN_KEY for JWT access+refresh tokens. Used for programmatic admin access.
Exchange a refresh JWT for a new access token. The refresh token must have type=refresh.

get.description: Returns all users that have a non-empty abuse_status field.

post.summary: Clear abuse status for a user
post.description: Resets the abuse_status field for the specified user, sends notification to user, and optionally recreates their subscription.
